karty.priklad: Mae fy mrawd i'n byw ym Mryste.
karty.priklad_cs: My brother lives in Bristol (Bryste → [M]ryste after yn = in; brawd → [m]rawd after fy; both nasal mutation).
karty.mnemo: Bryste is just Bristol with its tail chopped off – and tonight the harbour blazes with Bonfire Night fireworks.

extra.rod_pozn: place names are usually feminine in Welsh

karty.cs_upresneni: a bank branch or a tree branch
karty.priklad: Mae'r banc wedi cau'r gangen leol.
karty.priklad_cs: The bank has closed the local branch (cangen → [g]angen after 'r; lleol → [l]eol after a feminine noun).
karty.mnemo: A KANGaroo (CANG-en) sits on a branch of a tree that is on fire.

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n chwarae yn y gerddorfa.
karty.priklad_cs: She plays in the orchestra (cerddorfa → [g]erddorfa after y, feminine).
karty.mnemo: cerdd = music: the orchestra plays behind a glowing red FIRE DOOR (cerdd-DOR-fa).
rodina: -fa = place: meddygfa, meithrinfa, mynedfa, derbynfa (feminine, pl. -feydd)

karty.priklad: Wnei di gymwynas â fi?
karty.priklad_cs: Will you do me a favour? (cymwynas → [g]ymwynas as the object after wnei di)
karty.mnemo: 'Do me a favour: COME and WIN us (cym-WYN-as) the giant strawberry at the fair!'

karty.priklad: Ydy'r dderbynneb gyda chi?
karty.priklad_cs: Have you got the receipt? (derbynneb → [dd]erbynneb after 'r, feminine)
karty.mnemo: derbyn = to receive: the receipt proves you received it – it pops out of a red-hot toaster.

sever.priklad_cs: Have you got the receipt? (north: gynnoch chi instead of gyda chi)
sever.pozn: north: possession with gan (gen i, gynnoch chi) instead of gyda (L6)

karty.priklad: Dw i byth yn dilyn rheolau.
karty.priklad_cs: I never follow rules.
karty.mnemo: rheol ≈ RULE: the rules are painted on the side of a red pillar box.

extra.pozn: rh does not mutate after the article: y rheol

karty.priklad: Dw i erioed wedi bod ar set ffilm.
karty.priklad_cs: I've never been on a film set.
karty.mnemo: Same as English: on the film set a red fire engine sprays fake rain.

karty.priklad: Faswn i byth yn cymryd siawns.
karty.priklad_cs: I'd never take a chance. (cymryd siawns = to take a risk)
karty.mnemo: siawns sounds like 'chance': take a chance and bite the hottest chilli.

karty.priklad: Beth yw'r drefn heno?
karty.priklad_cs: What's the plan tonight? (trefn → [d]refn after 'r, feminine)
karty.mnemo: TREVor (TREF-n) puts everything in order – even the poppies in his garden stand in neat red rows.

extra.pozn: the plural trefniadau = 'arrangements' (same as the plural of masculine trefniad, L13)

sever.pozn: north: Be ydy instead of Beth yw (L5, L9)

karty.priklad: Dych chi wedi cwyno'n swyddogol i Aelod o'r Senedd?
karty.priklad_cs: Have you complained officially to a Member of the Senedd?
karty.mnemo: 'AYE, LOAD 'em up!' (AEL-od) – Members of the Senedd arrive in Cardiff Bay on an iceberg.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman member

sever.priklad: Dach chi wedi cwyno'n swyddogol i Aelod o'r Senedd?
sever.priklad_cs: Have you complained officially to a Member of the Senedd?

karty.priklad: Dw i wedi ysgrifennu at fy Aelod Seneddol i.
karty.priklad_cs: I've written to my MP.
karty.mnemo: 'AYE, LOAD 'em up!' (AEL-od) – this MP is pulled to Westminster on a husky sledge along the frozen Thames.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman MP

sever.priklad: Dw i wedi sgwennu at fy Aelod Seneddol i.
sever.pozn: north, colloquial: sgwennu instead of ysgrifennu (not in the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Faset ti'n codi baw ci wrth fynd am dro?
karty.priklad_cs: Would you pick up dog mess when you go for a walk?
karty.mnemo: 'BOW-WOW!' (BAW) – the dog's mess has frozen solid on the frosty pavement.

karty.cs_upresneni: one hair; pl. blew = fur, hair
karty.priklad: Mae blewyn yn fy nghawl i!
karty.priklad_cs: There's a hair in my soup! (cawl → [ngh]awl after fy)
karty.mnemo: 'BLEUGH, ONE!' (BLEW-yn) – a single hair in your ice-cold gazpacho.

extra.rod_pozn: blewyn is the singular of the collective noun blew

karty.priklad: Ticiwch y blwch cywir.
karty.priklad_cs: Tick the correct box.
karty.mnemo: 'BLOOCH!' (BLWCH) – the box plops through a hole in a frozen pond.

karty.priklad: Faswn i byth yn dweud celwydd.
karty.priklad_cs: I'd never tell a lie. (dweud celwydd = to tell a lie)
karty.mnemo: Every time you CALL WITH (CEL-wydd) a lie, your nose turns blue with frostbite.

karty.priklad: Dw i wedi bod ar gopa'r Wyddfa.
karty.priklad_cs: I've been on the summit of Snowdon (copa → [g]opa after ar).
karty.mnemo: A COPPER (COP-a) plants his flag on the summit in the middle of a blizzard.

karty.priklad: Faset ti'n rhoi cyflog mis i elusen?
karty.priklad_cs: Would you give a month's wages to charity?
karty.mnemo: Your wages are stored in a LOG cabin (cyf-LOG) in the Arctic, frozen solid.

karty.priklad: Mae'r heddlu'n chwilio am gyffuriau.
karty.priklad_cs: The police are looking for drugs (cyffuriau → [g]yffuriau after am).
karty.mnemo: Customs find drugs in a box of frozen fish fingers: 'CUFF him, SIR!' (CYFF-ur)

karty.priklad: Dw i wedi cwyno i'r cynghorydd lleol.
karty.priklad_cs: I've complained to the local councillor.
karty.mnemo: cyngor = council: the councillor holds every meeting in an igloo.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman councillor

karty.priklad: Mae'n wastraff amser.
karty.priklad_cs: It's a waste of time (gwastraff → [w]astraff after 'n).
karty.mnemo: All the WASTE floats away on a RAFT (gwas-TRAFF) across a freezing Arctic sea.

karty.priklad: Dw i erioed wedi gweithio fel gweinydd.
karty.priklad_cs: I've never worked as a waiter.
karty.mnemo: gweini = to serve + -ydd = person: the waiter is the one who serves – carrying drinks across a frozen ski-lift café.

karty.priklad: Dych chi'n llenwi holiaduron ar-lein?
karty.priklad_cs: Do you fill in questionnaires online?
karty.mnemo: holi = to question: the questionnaire interrogates you under a lamp in a walk-in freezer.

sever.priklad_cs: Do you fill in questionnaires online?

karty.priklad: Pa offeryn wyt ti'n ei chwarae?
karty.priklad_cs: Which instrument do you play?
karty.mnemo: 'OFFER IN!' (OFF-er-yn) – this week's special offer: a guitar carved out of ice.

karty.priklad: Dyw cael eich arian yn ôl ddim yn opsiwn.
karty.priklad_cs: Getting your money back isn't an option.
karty.mnemo: Same as English: the only option on the frosty menu is a blue ice lolly.

sever.priklad: Dydy cael eich pres yn ôl ddim yn opsiwn.
sever.priklad_cs: Getting your money back isn't an option.
sever.pozn: north: dydy instead of dyw (not in the coursebook), pres instead of arian (L4)

karty.cs_upresneni: a policy (set of rules), not politics (= gwleidyddiaeth)
karty.priklad: Beth yw polisi'r siop ar arian yn ôl?
karty.priklad_cs: What's the shop's policy on refunds?
karty.mnemo: Same as English: the shop's policy is clear – 'No walruses beyond this point'.

sever.priklad: Be ydy polisi'r siop ar bres yn ôl?
sever.priklad_cs: What's the shop's policy on refunds? (pres → [b]res after ar)
sever.pozn: north: Be ydy instead of Beth yw (L5), pres instead of arian (L4)

karty.priklad: Beth yw'ch profiad chi o ddefnyddio'r cyfryngau cymdeithasol?
karty.priklad_cs: What's your experience of using social media? (defnyddio → [dd]efnyddio after o)
karty.mnemo: A PRO with experience (PROF-iad) – she has crossed Antarctica on foot.

sever.priklad: Be ydy'ch profiad chi o ddefnyddio'r cyfryngau cymdeithasol?
sever.priklad_cs: What's your experience of using social media? (defnyddio → [dd]efnyddio after o)
sever.pozn: north: Be ydy instead of Beth yw (L5, L9)

karty.cs_upresneni: a table of data, not a piece of furniture (= bwrdd)
karty.priklad: Cysylltwch ddau hanner y tabl.
karty.priklad_cs: Match the two halves of the table. (dau → [dd]au as the object)
karty.mnemo: Like English 'table', but a table of data – drawn with a finger in the frost on a car windscreen.
